h1: Custom Kraft Jackets for Branded Workwear
metaDescription: Order custom kraft jackets for your team at Perfect Imprints. Durable, lightweight, and perfect for branding with logos.
introHtml: Kraft jackets offer a rugged, paper-like texture that stands out from standard fleece or nylon options. The natural brown hue provides a blank canvas for screen-printed or embroidered logos, making them ideal for trade shows, outdoor events, or warehouse teams. Bulk buyers appreciate the lightweight durability and affordable price point, especially when ordering for seasonal giveaways or uniform programs.
heroAltText: Custom kraft jackets with embroidered logo on chest, displayed on a mannequin
